weddings.name: Rachita & Akash
weddings.quote: I'm super happy with how great Nuptial Diaries was. From the first chat to getting our wedding photos, they were top-notch. Their crew did an amazing job, making sure every moment was perfect and really captured the fun and love of our day. They were awesome to deal with, making us feel at ease the whole time. The photos were way better than we expected and we're totally in love with them. I'm a big fan of ND and their team and would definitely suggest them to anyone looking for a skilled, dependable, and friendly photographer for their big day. Thanks again for making memories that we'll hold onto forever!

weddings.name: Revathi & Sachin
weddings.quote: We are incredibly happy with your shoots and clicks and have become completely engrossed in them. Our entire family and social circle is gushing about how amazing your pictures and videos are. To be quite honest, we have been having trouble choosing photos to post on social media for a while now. This is entirely due to your excellent photography.Their ability to capture both the grandeur of the surroundings and the intimate, candid moments between us was remarkable. The final images are a beautiful testament to their talent and dedication, showcasing not only the splendor of Mysore but also the essence of our relationship. Their photographic skills are impeccable and polished; They have an amazing ability to maneuver into and out of nearly awkward poses in order to capture the ideal shot. We will always be appreciative of everything they did for us both before and on our wedding day. The highlights, album, picture frames, and edits are all of very high caliber.

weddings.name: Preethi & Mithun
weddings.quote: Amazing Group! We were delighted with the prewedding and wedding photos taken by the "Awesome" team at Nuptial Diaries. They are the most skilled individuals, and what they do is "ohh so wow." There are no adequate words to express the caliber of work. It's Fantastic! Being associated with them made us feel fortunate and Instead of missing any of our priceless moments, they have made it the best we could have imagined.They captured candid moments and posed shots with equal finesse, resulting in a stunning collection of photographs that beautifully reflect our love and connection. In keeping with their work, pricing is also flawless and well-balanced. We couldn't be happier or more content. Many thanks to their team for this. Clearly, you are the ones who demand perfection. I hope you all have the happiest and most prosperous days.

weddings.name: Ramya & Suhas
weddings.quote: We thoroughly enjoyed working with Nuptial Diaries.The photography is beyond good, and the staff is even better. Each image is a perfect blend of artistic vision and heartfelt emotion, preserving the joy, love, and excitement we felt. Bharath didn’t just take pictures; they created timeless memories that we will cherish forever.  I adored their images. Every moment of my sister's wedding was exquisitely captured by them. Strongly advised... They exceeded expectations with their best results.

weddings.name: Sindhoora & Aravind
weddings.quote: We were fairly certain that we wanted Nuptial Diaries to shoot our wedding after seeing their work on Instagram. It ended up being among the greatest choices we could have made. They are extraordinarily skilled photographers who can take breathtaking pictures in the most ordinary settings. That is, however, fairly evident from their Instagram page. It does not, however, convey how enjoyable working with the ND team is. They are really polite, cheerful, and modest men. In a short amount of time, they became close friends, which was really helpful because it made the photo shoots a lot of fun. All we can say to anyone thinking about hiring them is to hire ND.

weddings.name: Eshita & Jigar
weddings.quote: We're super happy we picked ND as our wedding photographer. The photos turned out just as we hoped - a perfect blend of cute photos of us together all day, some great group shots, and tons of natural photos capturing all the fun and sweet moments. Their dedication was evident in every shot, beautifully documenting the vibrant colors, emotions, and traditions of our wedding. The final photographs exceeded our expectations, each one a perfect blend of artistic vision and heartfelt emotion.​. The quality and variety of the photos they made are top-notch. Going through them, it felt like he really captured the vibe of our day. Definitely recommend!

weddings.name: Supriya & Ravindra
weddings.quote: We are overjoyed with the whole experience of working with Nuptial Diaries to document our wedding, which we had the pleasure of hiring! We were immediately struck by Nuptial Diaries' warmth and professionalism. They continued to be a helpful friend as well as a photographer during the trip. It was their adaptability and willingness to go above and beyond that really made our wedding day unique. Each image is a work of art, carefully crafted to preserve the feelings, joy, and love we felt on our wedding day. Their photographic abilities are extraordinary; every shot flawlessly encapsulated the spirit and happiness of our special day. Their attention to detail is amazing, and the finished product far surpassed our expectations. The ability of NuptialDiaries to combine professionalism with a laid-back vibe is what makes them unique.

weddings.name: Mahima & Pradyumna
weddings.quote: We are so grateful that you captured our wedding; the pictures truly speak for themselves! You were simply incredible! All of our guests praised you for your skill and said that you had a natural ability to capture the ideal moment. I will be sure to suggest you to anyone else searching for a wedding photographer.

weddings.name: Soniya & Karan
weddings.quote: The memories that were captured so beautifully in the photos are something truly special that we'll treasure for years and generations to come. Not only did they make my wedding look stunning with their incredible skills, but they also made us feel so at ease in front of the camera. They're a big group of passionate and creative folks who love everything they do, which shows in their amazing work. From the photos to the videos, they've got it all covered. They definitely capture those candid moments too. I couldn't have been happier. They create magic with every photo they take. Thanks ND

weddings.name: Ramya & Srinivas
weddings.quote: We have received the best photography and videography service available to date from Nuptial Diaries. Only thanks to Nuptial Diaries' efforts were we able to capture the greatest photos and memories. First off, the team as a whole did an amazing job of coordinating the acceptance and delivery of the images, videos, films, and albums. Second, the team that photographed our memories was the most comfortable to work with; they were organized, professional, and punctual—all qualities that are crucial for wedding ceremonies. Thirdly, the editing is of exceptional quality. We can't look away from our wedding video! Their brand name has been justified, and when paired with music, it almost feels like a real movie.
